```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)

```


```{r}
bird_migratory_connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migratory_connectivity))
```
```{r}
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
```{r}
bird_migratory_selected <- bird_migratory_connectivity |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat
  )

gt(bird_migratory_selected)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
bird_migratory_exc <- bird_migratory_selected |> 
  filter(Site !="Spain")
gt(head(bird_migratory_exc))
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> 
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
```
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migratory_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```
```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)
```
```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}
gt(lat_df)
```
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migratory_exc |> 
  group_by(Site) |>
  summarise(Stopover_Latitude  = median(Stopover_Latitude),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude),
    Iberian_Latitude   = median(Iberian_Latitude),
    Iberian_Longitude  = median(Iberian_Longitude),
    Westmost_Latitude  = median(Westmost_Latitude),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude),
    Winter_Latitude    = median(Winter_Latitude),
    Winter_Longitude   = median(Winter_Longitude)
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
  
```
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```
```{r}
spring_types <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> 
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_types)
gt(spring_data)


```

```{r}
autumn_types <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost")
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |> 
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_types)
gt(autumn_data)
```


```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
```{r}
gt(spring_data)
```
```{r}
ggplot(spring_data, aes(
x = Longitude,
y = Latitude 
)) + 
  geom_point(colour = "red")
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point(colour = "purple") +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap()
```
```{r}
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min(na.rm = TRUE)
print(min_lon)

max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max(na.rm = TRUE)
print(max_lon)

min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min(na.rm = TRUE)
print(min_lat)

max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max(na.rm = TRUE)
print(max_lat)
```


```


```
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2))
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
